headline_seed: Rumen Radev looks set to win Bulgarian Parliamentary election
description_seed: Early results put his Progressive Bulgaria on 45%, well ahead of the liberal PP-DB coalition, which stood at 15%.

what: Rumen Radev looks set to win Bulgarian Parliamentary election

clean_source_blocks.text: Early results put his Progressive Bulgaria on 45%, well ahead of the liberal PP-DB coalition, which stood at 15%.

Pro-Russian former President Rumen Radev is on track for a decisive victory in Bulgaria’s 2026 parliamentary election, according to exit polls, marking a potential turning point in the country’s political landscape and foreign policy direction. Data from Sofia-based Alpha Research shows Radev’s Progressive Bulgaria party securing 44% of the vote, far ahead of the long-dominant GERB party led by Boyko Borissov, which trails at 12.5%. If confirmed, this result could deliver one of the strongest single-party performances in decades and possibly end years of fragile coalition governments that have triggered eight elections in just five years.
Rumen Radev's Progressive Bulgaria party looks set to win Sunday's Bulgarian Parliamentary election - the eighth general election in five years.

A former Mig-29 fighter pilot and commander-in-chief of the Bulgarian Air Force, his victory is impressive by Bulgarian standards, but does not give Progressive Bulgaria a strong enough mandate to govern alone.
